{{Top|leg}}
'''Operation False Horizon''' was an offensive that was launched by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to try and drive the [[Thaereian military]] out of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. The Militia captured or besieged all of the Thaereian bases in the system, causing most of the Thaereian troops on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to withdraw to the [[platform city]] [[Soboll]].
